race.comment: WRIGLEY FIELD (3) has been good without winning in town at his last three. Will appreciate a drop in grade and keeps Maloney. Bold showing anticipated. BOONDOCKS (1) is poised to win after placing at his last three outings and the form around him is stacking up strongly. Drawn sticky under the big weight but is still a genuine threat. BECAMO (8) has been hitting the line well over shorter trips and no rises sharply on the quick back-up. Is a two-time winner over this distance and has won here before. Deserves genuine consideration. HOLY FLASH (6) has been knocking on the door for a long time now and finds another suitable contest. Hot-hand hoop Williams taking over is a bonus.
